name: MTA Bridges and Tunnels Hourly Crossings: Beginning 2019
description: This dataset provides hourly bridge and tunnels crossings by facility, direction, vehicle class, and payment method. This dataset is a count of all traffic on the facilities, regardless of whether the driver ultimately pays the toll.

name: MTA Congestion Relief Zone Vehicle Entries: Beginning 2025
description: This dataset provides the number of crossings into the Congestion Relief Zone by crossing location and vehicle class, in 10-minute intervals. This data should not be used for revenue calculations, as entries do not include information about exemption statuses, payment methods, and repeat entries.

name: Automated Traffic Volume Counts
description: New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) uses Automated Traffic Recorders (ATR) to collect traffic sample volume counts at bridge crossings and roadways.These counts do not cover the entire year, and the number of days counted per location may vary from year to year.

name: Vehicle Classification Counts (2011 - 2025)
description: Vehicle classification counts collected by DOT for New York Metropolitan Transportation Council (NYMTC) to validate the New York Best Practice Model (NYBPM). For NYBPM screenline locations where data has been collected within the last three years are not considered for data collection for the present year. DOT collects data on at least 10% of the total NYBPM screenline locations.

name: Traffic Volume Counts (Historical)
description:
This is static historical dataset. New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) uses Automated Traffic Recorders (ATR) to collect traffic sample volume counts at bridge crossings and roadways. These counts do not cover the entire year, and the number of days counted per location may vary from year to year.

For a current feed of Automated Traffic Volume Counts, see: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/Transportation/Automated-Traffic-Volume-Counts/7ym2-wayt

name: MTA Bridges & Tunnels Hourly Traffic Rates: 2010 - 2025
description: This deprecated dataset provides data showing the number of vehicles (including cars, buses, trucks and motorcycles) that pass through each of the bridges and tunnels operated by the MTA each hour of the day. For a more detailed look traffic, refer to dataset https://data.ny.gov/d/ebfx-2m7v/.

name: Daily Traffic on MTA Bridges & Tunnels
description: This dataset provides data showing the number of vehicles (including cars, buses, trucks and motorcycles) that pass through each of the bridges and tunnels operated by the MTA each hour of the day. The data is updated weekly.
